slides.title: Bakery owners: the holiday rush paperwork quiz

slides.myth: Seasonal helpers don't need food handler cards
slides.fact: Many areas require them for anyone handling food, seasonal or not. Check your local rules.

slides.myth: Your shop permit covers the holiday market booth
slides.fact: Events often need their own temporary permit. Ask the organizer early.

slides.myth: An old COI is fine to send
slides.fact: An expired certificate won't count. Events want current dates.
